title: PySVOrbit: A Python Package for Combined Spectroscopic and Visual Orbit Fitting for Binary Stars
description: PySVOrbit fits Keplerian orbits of binary stars to relative astrometry and radial-velocity measurements, jointly or separately, by weighted non-linear least squares, and derives the associated dynamical masses. It reads classical .inp files and CSV variants, supports visual-only, spectroscopic-only and combined fits, and provides a browser-based interface.
